official_sources.title: gdal raster compare
official_sources.finding: Reference/golden comparison covers dimensions, datatype, nodata, pixel content and optional CRS/geotransform/overview/metadata checks; differences return nonzero status.

official_sources.title: gdal raster materialize
official_sources.finding: Materialization writes an on-demand pipeline dataset to disk; format, creation options and temporary path are derived-output provenance.

official_sources.title: gdal raster clean-collar
official_sources.finding: Clean-collar mutates edge pixels and can generate alpha/masks; it must not silently enter an elevation terminal chain.

official_sources.title: gdal raster index
official_sources.finding: Raster index records source filenames and footprints, supporting explicit tile/source inventory lineage.

official_sources.title: gdal raster edit
official_sources.finding: Raster edit can alter CRS, bounds, GCPs, nodata and statistics in place or auxiliary metadata; canonical assets require mutation detection.

official_sources.title: gdal raster nodata-to-alpha
official_sources.finding: Converting nodata to alpha or overriding nodata can change validity semantics without changing all numeric samples.

official_sources.title: gdal raster pipeline read
official_sources.finding: Pipeline read exposes input dataset, driver and open options that must be serialized for deterministic replay.

official_sources.title: gdal raster pipeline write
official_sources.finding: Pipeline write exposes output format and creation options; written output is derived evidence, not immutable source identity.

official_sources.title: gdal raster select
official_sources.finding: Band selection can reorder bands and turn a mask into an ordinary band; elevation and mask identities must be frozen.

official_sources.title: gdal raster stack
official_sources.finding: Stack combines input bands into virtual/materialized outputs; source order and per-band lineage must be retained.

official_sources.title: gdal raster tile
official_sources.finding: Retiling creates derived tiles under selectable schemes; derived tiles are not automatically native-cell evidence.

official_sources.title: gdal raster scale
official_sources.finding: Scaling can auto-compute ranges, clip values and change datatype; scaled outputs must not silently define terminal extrema.

official_sources.title: gdal driver cog validate
official_sources.finding: COG validation supports full strip/tile byte checks; remote full-check behavior must be explicitly pinned.

official_sources.title: gdal raster as-features
official_sources.finding: One feature per pixel can expose ROW/COL and pixel-center X/Y, enabling an independent native cell ledger.

official_sources.title: gdal raster update
official_sources.finding: Raster update mutates destination pixels and may reproject/resample and refresh overviews; canonical evidence must remain immutable.

official_sources.title: GDAL Virtual File Systems
official_sources.finding: Remote /vsicurl uses range requests and caches chunks; immutable digest/readback controls are needed for changing remote resources.

official_sources.title: GDAL configuration options
official_sources.finding: Networking, caching, threading and driver behavior can vary with configuration; runtime configuration is replay provenance.

official_sources.title: gdal raster create
official_sources.finding: Template creation can copy structure without pixel values; structural similarity must never be accepted as source-data identity.

official_sources.title: gdal raster overview add
official_sources.finding: Overview generation downsamples with a selected resampling method; overview lineage must remain separate from native full resolution.

official_sources.title: gdal vsi sync
official_sources.finding: A synchronized VSI copy requires post-copy byte digest verification before representing an immutable source.
